workshop.title: 把位置、顺序和时间各自对上
workshop.instruction: 比较新旧阅读环境，接好Then的前后动作，区分活动时长、钟点和有条件的调整。

items.label: 读清上周和现在
items.prompt: Which two clues show the change in the home reading setup?
items.answer: Leo now keeps the phone on a high shelf instead of beside the book.
items.reason: 上周放书边，现在在家阅读时放到高处的架子上。两句对照才看得到变化；图片只说明位置，不证明成绩提高。

items.material:
LEO'S NEW PLAN
Hi Ada,
Here is how I make room for reading.
Last week, I kept my phone beside my book when I read at home.
I often stopped to check messages instead of finishing a page.
Now I put my phone on a high shelf when I read at home.
I usually get home at 4:40 p.m.
I have a snack before I start my homework.
I work on homework for 25 minutes.
Then I take a five-minute break.
I usually read for twelve minutes before bed.
On Tuesdays, choir practice ends late, so I read for eight minutes on the train home instead.
I leave ten minutes unplanned because some homework questions take longer than I expect.
Best,
Leo
